symbols.name: CalendarProvider
symbols.description:
Provides shared calendar state (selection, config, range preview) to all
descendant view components. Does NOT manage focus, navigation, or grid data.

properties.name: format
properties.description:

`value`, `defaultValue`, `min`, `max`, and callback parameters.

properties.name: min
properties.description: Earliest selectable date. Dates before this are disabled.

properties.name: max
properties.description: Latest selectable date. Dates after this are disabled.

properties.name: disabled
properties.description: When `true`, the entire calendar is disabled.

properties.name: readOnly
properties.description:
When `true`, the calendar is read-only. Keyboard navigation still works
but selection is prevented.

properties.description:
Callback to disable individual dates. Return `true` to disable a date.

symbols.name: DayCellTemplate
symbols.description:
Renders one `<td role="gridcell">` per day. Exposes data-attributes for
`selected`, `today`, `disabled`, `outside-month`, `focused`,
`range-start`, `range-end`, `range-boundary`, `in-range`, and `date`.

When used inside a {@link WeekTemplate}, iterates over that week's days.
An explicit `date` prop renders a single cell.

symbols.name: RangeMode
symbols.description:
Controls how clicking inside an existing range behaves.
- `"start-end"` — Two-step: click sets start, second click sets end. Re-click resets.
- `"nearest-end"` — Adjusts whichever boundary is closer; ties go to end (default).
- `"nearest-start"` — Adjusts whichever boundary is closer; ties go to start.
- `"adjust-end"` — Always moves the range end to the clicked date.
- `"adjust-start"` — Always moves the range start to the clicked date.
- `"reset"` — Collapses the range to a single-day selection on the clicked date.
